description: What a rendered web page may ask Emerald's core to do. Six commands: five write-only reports about the page's own state, plus a relay for the keyboard chords Emerald owns (validated against a fixed allowlist in Rust), and nothing else — no settings, no tabs, no history, no filesystem, no shell. Every page webview is labelled `tab:<id>` and matched by that glob. The commands themselves derive the calling page's origin from `Webview::url()` in Rust and never from anything the page claims, so one site cannot read or overwrite another site's drafts.
